channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Quote of the Day: Mark Ruffalo's reminder to keep going – ‘Stick around, don’t lose your heart'
item.description: Mark Ruffalo’s words about not losing heart feel especially resonant when viewed against his own setbacks, his activism on Palestine and his willingness to take on powerful voices in Hollywood.

item.title: Bessent on Iran sanctions: 10 key points from Trump administration’s ‘economic asphyxiation’ plan
item.description: Bessent said the Trump administration would target Iran's financial connections, oil revenues and other economic lifelines as Washington seeks to increase pressure on Tehran nearly six months into the war.

item.title: Harvard advises international students to be in US before Sept 15 as new 4-year F-1, J-1 visa rule takes effect
item.description: The guidance comes amid uncertainty over how the new rule will affect students who travel outside the US after the effective date, as well as ongoing legal challenges seeking to block the changes.

item.title: ‘Operation Economic Outcast’: Why Trump’s ‘economic D-Day’ on Iran faces a tough test?
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Monday unveiled what he called ‘Operation Economic Outcast’, describing it as an ‘economic onslaught’ aimed at severing Iran’s financial links with the world.

item.title: New US sanctions against Iran: Bessent warns countries — Cut Iran ties or face the ‘full reach of American power’
item.description: “We are launching an economic onslaught against Iran’s financial connections around the globe,” Bessent said at a press conference. “Our objective is to sever every economic lifeline that sustains this tyrannical regime until Tehran stands alone.”

item.title: IIT Kanpur's Gangwal School of Medical Sciences gets ₹300 crore additional funds from IndiGo co-founder Rakesh Gangwal
item.description: IIT Kanpur's Gangwal School of Medical Sciences received ₹300 crore from co-founder Rakesh Gangwal, raising his total contribution to ₹400 crore. This funding will support a super-speciality hospital and a cancer care research centre.

item.title: RBI forex swap facility mobilises $73 billion, driven by $65.4 billion in FCNR deposits
item.description: The massive capital inflow builds crucial foreign-currency buffers for India's banking system amid heightened global market volatility.

item.title: Analogue paneer: How is it different from regular paneer? Price gap, home tests, why it was banned and how it’s made
item.description: Maharashtra, Gujarat, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and Karnataka are among the states that have taken action against analogue paneer.

item.title: Is Russia using Nvidia minicomputers to power AI drones? Report reveals how Moscow may be getting access
item.description: Ukrainian investigators say Russian forces have used Nvidia’s Jetson Orin computing modules in drones capable of identifying targets and making strike decisions without direct human confirmation

item.title: Income tax dept steps up prosecution of TDS defaults; Naftogaz India MD gets 22-month jail term
item.description: A Delhi court sentenced Naftogaz India MD Mahdoom Bava to 22 months in prison for failing to deposit ₹17.69 crore in TDS collected in FY 2009–10.&nbsp;

item.title: Labor Day 2026: Know the date, history, meaning and significance
item.description: The holiday has its roots in the American labor movement of the late 19th century, when workers and labor activists pushed for greater recognition of their contributions and better working conditions.

item.title: Piyush Goyal urges Japanese firms to double presence in India by 2030
item.description: The commerce minister’s Tokyo visit targets expanded investments across semiconductors, clean energy, and resilient supply chains to deepen bilateral ties.

item.title: ‘Immigration policies control our lives’: Former NRI explains why she left US to settle back in India | Watch video
item.description: Pankhuri, a former NRI from Indore, reflects on her family's return from America after 13 years. She cites cultural disconnect, longing for family connections, and immigration stress as key reasons for their decision.

item.title: Who is Karen Attiah? Arbitrator orders Washington Post to rehire columnist wrongfully fired over Charlie Kirk posts
item.description: Washington Post columnist Karen Attiah has been ordered to be reinstated with back pay after an arbitrator ruled she was wrongfully fired over social media posts following Charlie Kirk’s assassination. The Post had cited violations of its social media policy.

item.title: US Army Apache helicopters: Why crash rate is rising?
item.description: Apache’s reported crash rate in fiscal year 2026 is approximately 6.24 Class A mishaps per 100,000 flight hours.

item.title: Maharashtra govt increases cost of pollution check certificate; check revised rates for petrol, diesel, CNG vehicles
item.description: The cost of obtaining a PUC certificate in Maharashtra has been increased for different categories of vehicles.

item.title: Bengaluru weather baffles German woman living in the city: Social media calls it ‘Bangalore mood swings’
item.description: A German woman in Bengaluru shares her confusion about the city's chaotic traffic and rapidly changing weather in an Instagram video. Social media users chimed in with their reactions, comparing experiences in Germany and suggesting enjoying local cuisine to cope.

item.title: Women have bank accounts, but digital finance gap limits access to platform work: ILO-NCAER
item.description: The findings of the study assume significance as the number of platform workers in India has risen from an estimated 7.7 million in 2020 to 12 million in FY25

item.title: 'Know enough Marathi to carry out...': What CM Fadnavis said amid auto-taxi drivers' protest in Mumbai
item.description: The Maharashtra CM stated that the Mahayuti government would give enough time to drivers who want to learn the language.

item.title: H-1B visa fee could exceed $100,000 under new US plan — Check proposed charges
item.description: The proposed rule now begins a 30-day public comment period and could be finalized by the end of 2026.

item.title: 'The young will gather again': CJP to march from India Gate to Delhi Police HQ on Sept 5 over Centre's 'betrayal'
item.description: The Cockroach Janta Party has announced a peaceful protest march in Delhi on September 5, accusing the Centre of failing to honour commitments made on July 25 over FIRs against protesters, NEET-related compensation and exam reforms.

item.title: Trump raises tariffs on Canadian cars, trucks, auto parts and steel to 50% from 2027
item.description: Trump also urged companies to manufacture in the United States, saying products built domestically would face no tariffs.

item.title: US-Canada trade talks fail, 50% tariffs hit both sides: How will economies fare?
item.description: US-Canada trade talks collapse as both sides impose 50% tariffs, raising concerns over prices, jobs, trade and economic growth.

item.title: FDA suspends licences of 5 Mumbai Cricket Association restaurants
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the licences of five restaurants at the Mumbai Cricket Association over hygiene concerns, PTI reported citing officials.

item.title: 'Devoting personal attention': Putin credits PM Modi for India-Russia trade growth
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin credited PM Narendra Modi's personal attention for the growth in India-Russia trade this year. Putin also said he looks forward to meeting Modi at the SCO Summit during his meeting with EAM S Jaishankar in Moscow.

item.title: Govt eases medical device rules, speeds access to EU-approved products
item.description: Amendments to India's medical devices rules allow manufacturers to outsource sterilization without obtaining a separate loan licence if the third-party facility is already licensed.

item.title: US Trade Representative Greer blames Canada for collapse of trade deal talks: ‘They wanted more’
item.description: Greer's account contrasts with the explanation offered by Canadian prime minister, who have accused Washington of introducing new demands late in the negotiations.

item.title: India lifts wheat export curbs, shifts to free trade after four years
item.description: The decision comes after a year of strong agricultural output and a favourable wheat production outlook.

item.title: Bengaluru hospital's 'musical night' draws online backlash, CEO says ‘Patients don’t want to live in morose…'
item.description: Varun Dubey said the guest list had been carefully curated, while patients and their attendants were also welcome to attend.

item.title: Canada-US trade war: What went wrong in the negotiations and what comes next? | Explained
item.description: Canada-US trade talks collapsed over last-minute disagreements, triggering 50% US tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods. Canada will retaliate from September 8. The dispute threatens to deepen a trade war and reshape the countries' long-standing economic ties.

item.title: Gurugram advises WFH for corporate, govt offices on 25 August; schools to hold online classes amid rain, waterlogging
item.description: According to the advisory, continuous heavy rainfall is likely to cause waterlogging on several major roads and at intersections across the city, leading to traffic snarls during the day.

item.title: 'Normal practice': India reacts to US envoy's 'MEA sought no questions' remark on Modi-Trump meet
item.description: India said discussions on leaders' media appearances are normal practice ahead of VVIP visits after US envoy Sergio Gor said the MEA had sought no press interaction after the Modi-Trump meeting in France. Trump later took questions in a 45-minute interaction.

item.title: United Spirits withdraws HC plea after FSSAI revokes ban on its rum
item.description: United Spirits has withdrawn its Bombay High Court challenge against FSSAI restrictions on select liquor variants after the regulator revoked its order. The dispute involved added ‘rum flavour’. Old Monk maker Mohan Rocky continues to challenge a similar ban.

item.title: Mumbaikars pay '3 times' usual fare for autorickshaws as Marathi test kicks in: 'What are we achieving...?'
item.description: The enforcement drive has drawn criticism from members of the film fraternity as well as autorickshaw drivers, who have staged a three-day strike against the directive.

item.title: Bank holiday tomorrow: Check if SBI, HDFC, ICICI are open or closed on Tuesday, 25 August
item.description: Banks across India were closed on 23 August due to it being a Sunday. They will have multiple regional holidays this week. Check if banks are open or closed on 25 August.&nbsp;
